recommendedTextbook.title: Computer Studies for Junior Secondary Schools Book 2
recommendedTextbook.author: O. A. Bamiro, A. O. Nurudeen, M. O. Akande
recommendedTextbook.approvedBy: NERDC & Lagos State Ministry of Basic Education

topics.topic: Central Processing Unit (CPU) and Memory Hierarchy
subtopics: The CPU architecture: Control Unit (CU), Arithmetic Logic Unit (ALU), and Registers
Primary memory: RAM (Random Access Memory, volatile) vs ROM (Read Only Memory, non-volatile)
Secondary storage media: Hard Disk Drives (HDD), Solid State Drives (SSD), flash memory, optical disks (CD, DVD, Blu-ray)
objectives: Explain the fetch-decode-execute cycle of the microprocessor
Differentiate temporary RAM storage from permanent ROM BIOS chips
Compare storage capacity and data transfer speeds of HDDs vs NVMe SSDs

topics.topic: System Software: Operating Systems and Utilities
subtopics: Definition and core functions of an Operating System (processor, memory, file, and device management)
Types of Operating Systems: Single-user, multi-user, multi-tasking, distributed OS
User interfaces: Command Line Interface (CLI) vs Graphical User Interface (GUI)
objectives: State 4 functions performed by an operating system during computer operation
Distinguish text-based Command Prompt commands from GUI desktop icons
Identify common disk defragmentation and antivirus utility software

topics.topic: Number Bases in Computing: Binary, Octal and Hexadecimal
subtopics: Binary number system (Base 2): Bits, nibbles, bytes, kilobytes, megabytes, gigabytes, terabytes
Binary addition and subtraction using the two's complement principle
objectives: Convert decimal numbers up to 255 into 8-bit binary representation
Perform binary addition with carry bits accurately
Calculate storage capacity needed to store 500 digital textbook files in gigabytes

topics.topic: Word Processing: Document Creation and Formatting
subtopics: Introduction to word processors (Microsoft Word, Google Docs)
Document editing tools: Cut, copy, paste, undo, redo, spell check
Formatting features: Font styling, margins, bulleted lists, header and footer, table insertion
objectives: Create, format, and save an official letter in a word processor
Apply bullet points and line spacing to structured paragraphs
Demonstrate insertion of a 3-column timetable table into a word processing document
